summary: First full test of JKEE EPC ERP multi-company platform. Backend APIs extensively tested (40 tests, 97.5% pass rate). Frontend login, launchpad, dashboard, and navigation verified. Multi-company architecture, HR onboarding gate, approval workflows, and all 15 modules confirmed functional at API level.

Session timeout prevented extended UI flow testing, but since all backend APIs are working, frontend integration should be functional.
